# support (support.origincloudapis.eu)

Guide: <https://docs.origincloud.eu/docs/platform/support-cases/index.html.md>
Commands: `origin support <command>`. Add `--output json` to every command whose output you read.

- **CaseService**: Support cases: an organization's questions and problems, and where each one stands.
- **CaseMessageService**: A case's messages: its conversation between the organization and support, oldest first.

## Commands

### `origin support get-case`

Returns a case.

```sh
origin support get-case --case <CASE>
```

Also: `--organization <ORGANIZATION>`

### `origin support list-cases`

Lists an organization's cases, newest first.

```sh
origin support list-cases --organization <ORGANIZATION>
```

Also: `--page-size <PAGE_SIZE>`, `--page-token <PAGE_TOKEN>`

### `origin support create-case`

Opens a case, `OPEN`.

```sh
origin support create-case --organization <ORGANIZATION> --subject <SUBJECT> --description <DESCRIPTION> --contact-email <CONTACT_EMAIL>
```

Also: `--project <PROJECT>`, `--request-id <REQUEST_ID>`

- `--request-id` makes a retry safe

### `origin support close-case`

Closes a case: its `state` becomes `CLOSED`, and its contact email is notified.

```sh
origin support close-case --case <CASE>
```

Also: `--organization <ORGANIZATION>`

### `origin support reopen-case`

Opens a resolved or closed case again: its `state` becomes `OPEN`, and its contact email is notified.

```sh
origin support reopen-case --case <CASE>
```

Also: `--organization <ORGANIZATION>`

### `origin support get-case-message`

Returns one message of a case.

```sh
origin support get-case-message --message <MESSAGE>
```

Also: `--organization <ORGANIZATION>`, `--case <CASE>`

### `origin support list-case-messages`

Lists a case's messages, oldest first.

```sh
origin support list-case-messages --organization <ORGANIZATION> --case <CASE>
```

Also: `--page-size <PAGE_SIZE>`, `--page-token <PAGE_TOKEN>`

### `origin support create-case-message`

Adds a message to a case's conversation.

```sh
origin support create-case-message --organization <ORGANIZATION> --case <CASE> --body <BODY>
```

Also: `--request-id <REQUEST_ID>`

- `--request-id` makes a retry safe

## Resources

### Case

A support case: one question or problem, and the conversation about it.

- Full name: `//support.origincloudapis.eu/organizations/{organization}/cases/{case}`
- `name`: `organizations/{organization}/cases/{case}`

| Field (JSON) | Type | Behavior | About |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | identifier | The case's resource name, `organizations/{organization}/cases/{case}`. |
| `urn` | string | output only | The case's URN, the identifier access policies and the audit log use. |
| `project` | string | optional, immutable | The project the case is about, `projects/{project}`, one of the organization's. Names a `Project`. |
| `subject` | string | required, immutable | A one-line summary. |
| `description` | string | required, immutable | What the case is about, in full. |
| `contactEmail` | string | required, immutable | The email address every notification about the case is sent to, for as long as the case exists: when support replies, and when its state changes. |
| `state` | Case.State | output only | Where the case stands. One of `OPEN`, `IN_PROGRESS`, `RESOLVED`, `CLOSED`. |
| `creator` | string | output only | The principal that opened the case, such as `user:<id>` or `service_account:<id>`. |
| `createTime` | timestamp | output only | When the case was opened. |
| `updateTime` | timestamp | output only | When the case last changed: a message added, or its state changed. |

### CaseMessage

One message of a case's conversation.

- Full name: `//support.origincloudapis.eu/organizations/{organization}/cases/{case}/messages/{message}`
- `name`: `organizations/{organization}/cases/{case}/messages/{message}`

| Field (JSON) | Type | Behavior | About |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | identifier | The message's resource name, `organizations/{organization}/cases/{case}/messages/{message}`. |
| `body` | string | required, immutable | The message's text. |
| `author` | string | output only | The principal that wrote the message, such as `user:<id>` or `service_account:<id>`. |
| `createTime` | timestamp | output only | When the message was added. |
